items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness adds Strands harness defaults, built-in tools, and lifecycle hooks
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness now runs on the open-source Strands harness, bringing a recommended model, task-oriented defaults, automatic prompt caching, proactive context management, and new built-in tools. It also adds lifecycle hooks so you can run deterministic allow or deny checks at defined points in the agent loop.
items.creator: Evandro Franco

items.title: Amazon Polly launches voice cloning: A unique voice for your brand
items.summary: Voice cloning in Amazon Polly is now generally available. Give Amazon Polly a few minutes of recordings from a consenting speaker, and it builds a custom voice that reads new text in that speaker's voice. Cloned voices run on the Amazon Polly generative engine and support seven languages.
items.creator: Suyin Wang
